n0.hypothesis: Train native-512 Aperture at four times the preview pace with faithful motion and recovery and at least 32 measured local frames per second
n0.insight:
[from n1] Inference cost can be reduced independently of video fidelity; select rules using native signed-motion measurements, not parameter count or offline playback frame rate.
[from n2] The first native-512 candidate needs a better representation of oblique contours; extending optimization alone improved images but did not meet signed-motion fidelity.
[from n3] Learned factorized spatial/time features improve contour fidelity while keeping the local rule small. Measure carried-state dependence because phase conditioning and read-only features alone can otherwise masquerade as recurrent dynamics.
[from n4] The compact rule with learned factorized priors reaches 28dB native512 reconstruction, faithful signed motion, sustained perturbation recovery and 136fps synchronized RGB readback on M4 Max. Validate with a frozen long rollout and report external-phase, single-preset limits.

n1.hypothesis: A compact native-512 phase-conditioned rule with direct RGB readout can learn the simple fast Aperture motion while meeting local runtime limits
n1.insight:
A 12236-parameter coordinate/Fourier rule is fast on MPS but the short pilot has not learned the moving rounded contours. Test more optimization before adding capacity.
[from n2] The first native-512 candidate needs a better representation of oblique contours; extending optimization alone improved images but did not meet signed-motion fidelity.

metadata.result: 3000 updates: PSNR12.56dB, signed motion cosine0.076, projected gain0.021; native contact sheet shows blurred nearly stationary stripes. Function108.83s, estimated0.0381USD.

n2.hypothesis: Increasing compact-rule training from 3000 to 18000 updates will recover signed contour motion without increasing inference cost
n2.insight: More optimization improves coarse geometry but still attenuates the moving edges. Use learned spatial/time priors while retaining the measured small update backbone.

metadata.result: 18000 updates improve PSNR12.56 to17.27dB, motion cosine0.510 and gain0.339, but still fail the fixed motion gate; function503.71s and0.1763USD.
metadata.prune_reason: 18000 updates remain below the fixed signed-motion cosine and gain gates; pursue a representation change before spending on further coordinate-only optimization.

n3.insight:
Small shared learned spatial/time priors resolve enough oblique contour structure to pass at one native-512 update per frame, without widening the backbone.
